description: This source file contains helper methods for integration testing articles within the Conduit project. It provides a method to create an article with associated setup such as creating a default user and interacting with the database context.

classes.name: ArticleHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for article-related integration tests.

methods.name: CreateArticle
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an article in the test database using a provided command, ensuring a default user exists, and handles possible errors during creation.
